name: SOC Framework NIST IR (800-61) - AI Analysis
description: Case-scoped Detection & Analysis for the NIST IR lifecycle. Side-loads alongside SOC Framework NIST IR (800-61) with no effect until its entry point is bound to the automation trigger. Ships the case-analysis JOB, its per-case sub-playbook, and an entry point that ends at Upon Trigger so the NIST phases run once per case instead of once per issue. Install on AI-capable tenants only: the AI Prompt is created by hand and the sub-playbook aiTask bound to it after install. See README.md.
author: Cortex XSOAR
